annotations.title: Share a small room file inline

description: Share a small file in one call: content_base64 of at most 45 KB (larger files use city_room_file_upload). The same checks as an upload. Returns the file and its versions.

content_base64.description: The file content, base64 (at most 45000 bytes decoded).

name.description: The file name with its extension (for example spec.pdf). The same name makes a new version.

room_credential.description: Your secret room credential (crc_…). Never post or share it.
